extraction: Exact test-emitted JSON parsed from timestamp-stripped GitHub job logs; wrapper only. Software loopback observations, not physical or two-machine latency.

comparison.interpretation: same binary/process AB then BA; negative B-A is lower observed latency. All results including regressions retained; descriptive small-sample comparison, no performance threshold or cross-CI-run comparison.

report.configuration: identical binary, process, fps, quality, selected surfaces, input gates, retained-frame billing and response workload; only the per-host-thread test-only input-wake switch differs
report.counter_scope: per-host-thread owned collector, whole session including warmup/setup/cleanup; eventfd accumulated hints are not input-action counts or CPU utilization. Activity waits count calls, not early poll wake returns; no poll-return cause counter is collected. Generous fixed iteration bounds catch runaway loops, not a hardware performance gate.
report.lease_policy: fresh session per occurrence; no renewal; 25s checked budget per session including setup, bounded teardown excluded from latency measurement

sessions.budget: 25s checked including setup and after each sample; synchronous fixture operations and teardown have their own bounded waits, so this is not a strict wall-clock process cap
sessions.endpoints: injection before click wire requests; recipient observed after fixture dispatch; app commit request submitted; actual GL readback marker verified; exact client presentation feedback observed. Includes polling/readback/test feedback overhead, not physical input or scanout; no cross-machine claim.

environment.gl_renderer: production headless Smithay GLES; driver identity not queried
environment.topology: single-process owned dual Wayland displays and loopback authenticated TCP
